result: An append-only date ledger pins calendar version, tradability and settlement deadline. Holidays become immutable NO_TRADE; special-session overrides remain eligible; completed and no-trade runner outcomes are recorded; feed loss or premature stop records INCOMPLETE; overdue missing outcomes are swept to INCOMPLETE. Cross-journal recovery is idempotent.
focused_tests: 86 passed (forward-session crash, runner, clock, Kite, intraday, session-date, and book integration)
limitations: Completeness depends on scheduling every eligible date from an authoritative versioned calendar, supplying correct special-session deadlines, and running the overdue sweep.
